name: voice-light-field
title: Voice-reactive fluid light
summary: The listening / Live Talk light at the bottom of the screen: Figma's six blurred light layers re-rendered as one flowing field (curl flow, per-layer warp and travel, rising crests) that reacts to a voice level (WebGL).
renderer: WebGL1 (one shared context per page) copied into a 2D canvas per instance
samples: Its own mask textures only (ten Figma layer exports, packed into an atlas at startup). Never samples page content.
playback: Controlled frame {flow, level, mix} (pure, seekable) or live voiceLevel integrated by stepLight on the effect's own clock; flow never restarts, so level changes are interruptible and reversible.
reducedMotion: still: the light holds (no flow), level still applies. Host passes it.
